description: This source file implements core functionalities of the he_bus system, including initialization, deinitialization, registration, lookup, event handling, messaging, and subscription management for a bus communication architecture in a Linux-based environment.

classes.name: he_bus_handle_t
classes.description: Handle representing a connection or session to the bus system, used throughout the API functions.

classes.name: he_bus_mgr_t
classes.description: Manager structure maintaining global bus state, server thread info, and initialization flags.

classes.name: element_node_t
classes.description: Structure representing a node in the bus data tree, with properties like name, type, children, parent, and related callback handlers.

classes.name: he_bus_data_element_t
classes.description: Structure defining a data element's metadata for registration into the bus.

classes.name: he_bus_raw_data_t
classes.description: Holds raw binary data and associated type info for messages exchanged over the bus.

methods.description: Opens a bus client connection, starting communication threads.
